# Awesome Loop

> Looped and recurrent-depth language models. Each deep card records the loop layout, what the main comparison holds fixed, the paper's results with table or figure references, and caveats taken from the paper. All numbers are author-reported; nothing is converted or extrapolated. Comparison keys: params = unique parameters, active-params = active parameters, flops = training FLOPs, kv = KV cache per token, tokens = training tokens, depth = executed layers per token, wallclock = wall-clock time.

## Deep cards

- [Inkling 2 Mini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/tml-inkling-2-mini.md): Open-weight MoE (26.4B total, 3.4B active) that runs the middle 12 of its 24 layers three times with shared weights, released with a variable-loop research twin used to measure how pass count affects capability and CoT monitorability. Layout: L0-5 (6 layers) -> [L6-17 (12 layers)] x 3 -> L18-23 (6 layers); injection depth-attention; KV per-pass. Held fixed: flops; differs: none.
- [Looped CED](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2611.13378.md): Loop the CED encoder layers that produce global KV, train with random depth, and keep only the last round's KV. Layout: L0-1 (2 layers) -> [L2-5 (4 layers)] x max(1, Poisson(8)) -> L6-11 (6 layers); injection gated; KV last-pass. Held fixed: params, tokens, kv; differs: flops, depth.
- [LoopDuet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2611.07211.md): Serve looped Transformers with fewer core loops for ordinary prompt tokens than for the last prompt token and the decoded tokens, run the deep tail as a compact batch in vLLM, and lower prefilling depth when the queue grows. Layout: prelude 4 layers -> [core 6 layers] x 32 (OLMo r32 checkpoint) -> coda 4 layers; injection n/a; KV last-pass. Held fixed: params, tokens, kv; differs: depth, wallclock.
- [SMELT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2609.01343.md): With per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV cache matched, looping the middle half of an MoE Transformer twice lowers loss at four scales up to 54B non-embedding parameters and saves 6.8-18.0% of training FLOPs on the fitted frontier. Layout: L1-3 (3 layers) -> [L4-9 (6 layers)] x 2 -> L10-12 (3 layers); injection none; KV per-pass. Held fixed: flops, params, kv, tokens; differs: active-params, depth.
- [Parcae](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2604.12946.md): Constrain the loop's injection to a stable negative-diagonal form, sample depth per sequence, and fit training and test-time scaling laws for looping at fixed parameter count. Layout: prelude 8 layers -> [core 8 layers] x Poisson with mean 8, per sequence -> coda 8 layers; injection gated; KV n/a. Held fixed: params, tokens; differs: flops, depth.
- [YOCO-U](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2604.01220.md): Loop only YOCO's self-decoder, whose layers use sliding-window attention, so extra depth costs compute while the cross-decoder's global KV is still computed once. Layout: [Universal Self-Decoder, SWA-512 (10 layers)] x 3 -> Cross-Decoder, shared global KV (10 layers); injection none; KV single-global. Held fixed: params, active-params, flops; differs: tokens, depth, kv.
- [Retrofitted Recurrence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2511.07384.md): Turn pretrained 1B models into prelude-core-coda recurrent models by dropping middle layers and looping a block, then keep training while a curriculum raises the mean recurrence. Layout: L0-3 (4 layers) -> [L10-17 (8 layers)] x Poisson-Lognormal, mean ramped to 4, 8, 16 or 32 -> L18-21 (4 layers); injection concat; KV n/a. Held fixed: tokens; differs: params, flops, depth.
- [Ouro (LoopLM)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2510.25741.md): Pre-train a weight-tied layer stack that repeats 4 times, with a learned exit gate, on 7.7T tokens; the authors report that the 1.4B and 2.6B models match dense models of up to 12B parameters. Layout: [whole stack (2.6B: 48 layers) (24 layers)] x 8 in Stage 1a, then 4; injection none; KV per-pass. Held fixed: none; differs: params, tokens.
- [PLT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2510.24824.md): Run loop l of token i in the same forward pass as loop l+1 of token i-1, let later loops reuse the first loop's KV plus a gated SWA, and a looped model decodes at close to unlooped latency and KV. Layout: [all layers, every loop (100% of layers)] x 2 or 3 (PLT-2 / PLT-3); injection additive; KV first-pass. Held fixed: params, active-params, tokens; differs: flops, depth, kv.
- [MoR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2507.10524.md): Routers give each token its own number of passes through a shared middle block, and each pass caches KV only for its active tokens; at equal training FLOPs MoR beats fixed-depth recursive baselines and often vanilla, with fewer parameters. Layout: first layer (1 layer) -> [shared block (10 layers)] x 1-3 per token, set by the router (Nr=3) -> last layer (1 layer); injection none; KV per-pass. Held fixed: flops; differs: params, tokens, depth, kv.
- [Huginn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/2502.05171.md): Pretrain a 3.5B prelude-core-coda transformer with a randomly sampled number of core iterations, so test-time compute scales by iterating the core more. Layout: P (2 layers) -> [R (4 layers)] x log-normal Poisson, mean 32 -> C (2 layers); injection concat; KV per-pass. Held fixed: params, tokens; differs: flops, depth.

## Open questions

- [Does running more passes at test time than in training keep improving quality?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/questions.md#extra-passes-at-test-time): mixed; Models trained with a sampled or variable number of passes stay flat or improve slightly beyond the training depth, and their gains level off near the training mean. Ouro, trained with 4 steps and learned exits rather than sampled depth, loses accuracy at 5-8 steps. No source trains the same model both ways, so the role of sampled-depth training is not isolated.
- [Where in the stack should the loop sit?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/questions.md#loop-placement): consistent; Every comparison favors looping lower or middle layers over the whole stack or the top layers, and in layouts with a shared global KV the loop should include the layers that produce it. The comparisons come from models of 1.3B parameters or less, or from runs whose sizes are not given.
- [With training compute held fixed, do more passes help?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/questions.md#more-passes-fixed-compute): mixed; On language modeling at the budgets tested, SMELT and MoR find two passes better than three or four with FLOPs fixed, and in Ouro the gap to untied models of the same executed depth grows with the step count. Other results point the other way: Parcae's compute-optimal number of passes rises with the training budget, deeper training recurrence pays off per training FLOP for two of three retrofitted model families, and on Ouro's synthetic Mano task more passes of fewer layers win at the same executed depth.
- [Can later passes reuse one KV cache instead of keeping KV for every pass?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/docs/en/questions.md#shared-kv-across-passes): mixed; Reusing the last pass's KV works when the model is trained for it or when it is done only during decoding, while reusing the first pass's KV alone costs accuracy unless a local window is added. Looped CED loses nothing with last-round KV under sampled-depth training but fails with fixed depth, Ouro keeps quality with last-step KV in decoding but not in prefill, and PLT needs a gated sliding window on top of first-pass KV sharing.

## Open models

- [Huginn-0125](https://huggingface.co/tomg-group-umd/huginn-0125): paper 2502.05171; 3.5B params; 800B training tokens; passes 32; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Inkling 2 Mini](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini): paper tml-inkling-2-mini; 26.4B params; not stated training tokens; passes 3; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Ouro-1.4B](https://huggingface.co/ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B): paper 2510.25741; 1.4B params; 7.7T training tokens; passes 4; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Ouro-2.6B](https://huggingface.co/ByteDance/Ouro-2.6B): paper 2510.25741; 2.6B params; 7.7T training tokens; passes 4; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Parcae](https://huggingface.co/SandyResearch/parcae-140m): paper 2604.12946; 140M / 370M / 770M / 1.3B params; 11.2B / 29.6B / 61.6B / 104B training tokens; passes 8; KV per-pass; license not stated on the model cards.
- [Recurrent-Llama-3.2 (4,6,4)](https://huggingface.co/smcleish/Recurrent-Llama-3.2-train-recurrence-4): paper 2511.07384; 851,501,056 excluding embeddings (Table 8) params; about 50B (Nemotron-CC-Math-v1) training tokens; passes 32; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Recurrent-OLMo-2-0425 (4,6,4)](https://huggingface.co/smcleish/Recurrent-OLMo-2-0425-train-recurrence-4): paper 2511.07384; 939,638,784 excluding embeddings (Table 8) params; about 50B (Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus) training tokens; passes 32; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [Recurrent-TinyLlama-3T (4,8,4)](https://huggingface.co/smcleish/Recurrent-TinyLlama-3T-train-recurrence-4): paper 2511.07384; 704,708,608 excluding embeddings (Table 8) params; about 50B (train-recurrence-k repos); 26B single phase, 52B two phase training tokens; passes 32; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.
- [TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research): paper tml-inkling-2-mini; 26.4B params; not stated training tokens; passes 3; KV per-pass; license apache-2.0.

## Data

- [papers.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/data/papers.json): every paper entry (deep and radar) as JSON
- [models.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/data/models.json) and [claims.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/data/claims.json)
- [metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/data/metrics/latest.json): citations, stars, Hugging Face upvotes and downloads
- [schema](https://github.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/tree/main/schema): field definitions and allowed values
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjy1203/awesome-loop/main/llms-full.txt): all English deep cards in one file
